name: Canonical identity
given: Same ticker on two chains or token programs
expected: Reject cross-identity coupling even if decimals match

name: Amount-local rejection
given: First amount has zero/negative output; later amount is valid
expected: Return a per-amount reason and retain valid samples; unknown state rejects all affected samples

name: Sizing owner
given: SOL/WSOL and USDC amounts passed to PR118 boundary
expected: Lamports accepted only with proper identity; other units require an explicit reviewed owner extension

name: Route invariants
given: Reordered edges, repeated venue, stale leg and slot mismatch fixtures
expected: Stable semantic ID where appropriate; changed evidence ID; invalid route rejects without quote scaling

name: Stock versus flow
given: TVL, OI, volume and stablecoin cap loaded together
expected: Store distinct metric types; aggregation into one size is invalid

name: Routed flow
given: Aggregator hop and underlying DEX fill describe one trade
expected: Underlying gross volume and user flow remain separate without double counting

name: Available-at
given: A revised historical series appears after the research cutoff
expected: Earlier decision receives only the earlier available version

name: Missing coverage
given: A venue disappears from one source
expected: Coverage decreases or is unknown; absent data never becomes zero activity

name: Retry budget
given: One job causes three physical attempts and two billable responses
expected: Charge actual request/credit units through the existing authority

name: Entitlement expiry
given: Provider key plan or license generation changes
expected: Cancel or re-admit affected jobs; do not keep stale rights

name: Unlimited free assumption
given: Mainnet paid stream selected by a free profile
expected: Reject profile or require separately budgeted eligible source; no purchase

name: Quota fairness
given: Discovery flood competes with near-deadline hot work
expected: Bound queue and preserve policy fairness without unbounded retries

name: Orderbook gap
given: Snapshot and sequence updates have a missing range
expected: Invalidate book and dependent candidates until documented resync

name: Absolute level size
given: Coinbase level size changes from 7 to 3
expected: New size is 3, not 10; zero removes it

name: Fork/reorg
given: Removed log or Solana fork invalidates an applied update
expected: Retract dependent evidence and reconstruct from valid ancestor

name: Crash restore
given: Process dies between raw append, state application and cursor commit
expected: Recovery reconstructs a consistent hash without skipping or double applying

name: Rights aliases
given: Two stablecoins share peg text but different redemption access
expected: Do not create an exact conversion relation

name: Maturity claim
given: PT/YT or RWA claim pays later
expected: Separate dated cashflow from immediate assets and flashloan closure

name: Vector transformation
given: LP split has two outputs and one input
expected: All asset deltas and conservation constraints explicit; no single-edge scalar approximation

name: Eligibility drift
given: Whitelist or product cap changes
expected: Invalidate relation eligibility generation before candidate admission

name: Worker determinism
given: Same valid frame searched with 1, 2 and 4 workers
expected: Same bounded candidate set and stable ordering, independent of completion order

name: Bound exhaustion
given: Expansion/candidate limit reached
expected: Report truncation and explored coverage; no full-graph completeness claim

name: Targeted invalidation
given: One pool changes while an unrelated component is stable
expected: Invalidate all dependent candidates and preserve unaffected work

name: Evidence identity
given: Same semantic route with new state or amount
expected: Semantic/evidence identities handled separately without duplicated logical opportunity

name: Shared pool capacity
given: Two paths draw from the same pool reserves
expected: Joint transitions recompute outputs; independent quote sums rejected

name: Order sensitivity
given: A→B and B→A path execution orders differ
expected: Evaluate both bounded orders and bind selected evidence to order

name: Finite optimality
given: Best amount lies outside sampled integer grid
expected: Report best sampled point only; do not assert continuous optimum

name: Cost additivity
given: Extra path repeats base fee assumption or adds one fixed cost
expected: Charge correct transaction-level and per-leg costs without double counting

name: Read/write locks
given: One candidate reads an account another writes
expected: Conflict even if their writable sets do not intersect

name: Read/read sharing
given: Independent routes read the same immutable/versioned oracle
expected: No lock conflict solely for read/read; stale oracle still rejects

name: Lender and payer
given: Disjoint swap pools share reserve cash or fee payer
expected: Conflict/capacity restriction survives separate worker IDs

name: Hidden accounts
given: Adapter omits a hook, fee recipient or shared margin account
expected: Qualification rejects incomplete footprint instead of assuming independence

name: Two-process reservation race
given: Two workers reserve same attempt identity
expected: Exactly one authoritative reservation and version transition

name: Zombie worker
given: Old worker completes after a new fencing generation is granted
expected: Reject old output and retain current authority state

name: Pre-submission expiry
given: Pure compute job expires before any external side effect
expected: Release only its allowed reservations through canonical authority

name: Unknown external outcome
given: Future lifecycle evidence cannot determine settlement
expected: Keep economic hold; compute TTL never reuses uncertain funds

name: Overload
given: Input rate exceeds processing budget for sustained interval
expected: Bound memory/queue and expose dropped/coalesced work without hiding state gaps

name: Tail deadline
given: A high-score job finishes after its route deadline
expected: Discard admission despite valid old simulation

name: Cache identity
given: Same pool amounts but decoder/fee/frame version changed
expected: Cache miss or invalidation; never reuse evidence across versions

name: Network partition
given: Remote stateless worker loses coordinator access
expected: Cannot reserve or promote work locally; results remain unadmitted

name: Finite selection optimum
given: Six-route illustrative fixture in this archive
expected: Selected B,C,E score20 versus greedy18 at max3; shared payer admits only best single candidate

name: Missing budget dimension
given: Claim includes margin or data quota absent from supplied budgets
expected: Reject incomplete budget rather than implicitly treating it as unlimited

name: Correlated stress
given: Two strategies depend on same oracle/provider/collateral
expected: Joint scenario loss includes common shock; additive tail score not labeled CVaR

name: Sequential reuse
given: Loan repaid in one modeled wave then another route considered
expected: Recompute new state/capacity; do not use pending or failed repayment as cash

name: Flash premium change
given: Governance or reserve revision changes premium
expected: Recompute exact repayment; reject stale terms binding

name: Multiasset debt
given: One borrowed asset is short by one atom but USD total is positive
expected: Reject closure; no cross-asset scalar offset

name: Shared lender cash
given: Several Morpho markets map to one contract token balance
expected: Count capacity once under common resource identity

name: Scope boundary
given: Flash principal expected to persist across a bridge, bundle transaction or resting order
expected: Reject unsupported funding scope; inventory path remains separate

name: Look-ahead join
given: Faster feed arrives before a delayed source timestamp suggests
expected: Use available_at plus transport history; no future observation enters features

name: Multiple testing
given: Many pairs/lag windows tried and only winners retained
expected: Register all trials and control chosen test family with dependence-aware validation

name: Serial dependence
given: Many overlapping trades derived from one shock
expected: Report effective independent episodes and purged/embargoed holdout

name: Null and latency controls
given: Independent series and injected feed delays generate apparent lead/lag
expected: Reject unstable relation or mark insufficient evidence; cost-adjusted result remains separate

name: Queue optimism
given: Quote touches best price without consuming queue ahead
expected: No automatic full fill; simulate explicit queue bounds

name: Cancel race
given: Market moves during cancel acknowledgment delay
expected: Account for fills during delay and persist residual inventory

name: Cash classification
given: Resting maker quote funded only by temporary flash principal
expected: Reject funding plan; owned inventory/eligible credit and collateral required

name: Markout accounting
given: Earned fees accompany adverse price moves
expected: Report total mark-to-market PnL, hedges and inventory costs, not fees alone

name: Per-user clearing
given: Aggregate surplus positive but one order limit violated
expected: Reject allocation; collective objective cannot override individual constraints

name: Compute evidence fraud/error
given: Provider signs result that fails independent semantic check
expected: Reject payment eligibility in model; signature alone is not correctness

name: Strategic response
given: Mechanism changes incentives from frozen historical flow
expected: Report sensitivity over response models, not a causal guarantee

name: Subsidy removal
given: Service appears used only while rewarded
expected: Separate paid retained demand from incentives and internal self-trades

name: New-chain identity
given: Chain name/ID matches but genesis or deployment differs
expected: New qualification required; never auto-enable by ticker/chain label

name: All-free coverage claim
given: Catalog contains public, paid and unverified endpoints
expected: Expose access tiers and tested coverage denominator; no full-market claim

name: Disabled runtime boundary
given: Research profile loaded with orderbook or live options
expected: No activation; existing disabled strategy and execution boundary preserved

name: Scale success criterion
given: More workers raise requests but not useful timely evidence
expected: Fail scale gate or reduce workers; no success based on raw throughput alone
